question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**poisonous**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about an old man.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**poisonous**'.
 
• In the given context it means 'very unpleasant and unkind बहुत ही अप्रिय और निर्दयी'.
 
 
• *Example: He said some **poisonous** things to me.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *An old man lived in the village. He was one of the most unfortunate people in the world. The whole village was tired of him; he was always gloomy, he constantly complained and was always in a bad mood. The longer he lived, the more vile he was becoming and the more **poisonous** were his words.*
